Alley Cats Screen Printing

What are
the shirts for?

From an existing logo to a brand-new shirt design, we’ll help you match the garment, artwork, and print to the occasion.

Business & crew shirts

Put your company name on the people representing it. Custom work shirts keep your crew easy to recognize on the job and around town.

Church & ministry apparel

Shirts for church groups, youth events, outreach, retreats, and fundraisers—with design help to bring your message together.

Schools & spirit wear

Show your school colors with shirts for student groups, clubs, spirit days, and school events.

Teams & organizations

Custom apparel for teams, gyms, clubs, and community groups. Make the shared identity something people can wear.

Fundraisers & special events

A memorable design for a reunion, benefit, community event, or campaign. Let us know your quantity and event date.

Custom shirt design

Bring your artwork or let Relevant Design help create it. We’ll work through placement, ink colors, and the finished look before printing.

Good to know

Before you order.

Call the shop at (601) 736-0663.

Contact Relevant↗
What affects the price of screen printed shirts?

The garment, quantity, number of ink colors, print locations, and artwork needs all affect the price. Send those details and your deadline for an accurate quote.

Can I see the design before printing?

Yes. We review the design proof and project details with you before production. Check names, spelling, sizes, colors, and placement carefully when you approve your proof.

Can you reproduce a previous order?

Tell us the business or organization name and what you ordered before. We’ll review the available artwork and order details, then confirm garments, quantities, and current pricing.

What can we
make for you?

Tell us what you need, how many, and when you need it. We’ll help you work out the details.
